purpose: Test target alignment and peer avoidance separately on the three fixed C final models without retraining or changing the formal E009 submission

target.single_change: Blend the original PPO action with the unit direction to the nearest currently visible target

avoid.single_change: Add a repulsive action away from currently visible peers within 0.30 distance

evaluation.primary_comparison: Each variant versus its unchanged C model on all development v2 scenes, with paired seed scores, basic/cooperation coverage, collisions and score; no variants combined

screening_rule.target: Basic coverage improves for at least two of three seeds; mean score loses fewer than 5 points; mean cooperation collision rate does not rise by more than 0.005
screening_rule.avoid: Cooperation collision rate falls for at least two of three seeds; mean score loses fewer than 5 points; mean basic coverage does not fall by more than 0.01

final_confirmation_policy: Do not use A4 final-confirmation suite for these development experiments
